races.paceDynamic: Fitzella and Hassaleh will contest the early lead with both confirmed front-runners likely to engage from the gates. This dual-pace attack should create an honest gallop throughout the 6f trip, preventing any crawling sectionals that would suit pure closers. The sustained tempo will test stamina reserves in the final furlong, with those positioned close enough to strike but not embroiled in the early battle holding a tactical edge. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers and forward-positioned horses who can track the leaders without getting caught in the speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Fitzella and Hassaleh clash early and both weaken significantly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong gallop takes its toll on the leaders, creating gaps for those held up with finishing kicks. Patient riders on closers can time their runs perfectly as the pace crumbles ahead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Fitzella or Hassaleh establishes a clear advantage and the other concedes early
scenarios.body: The surviving leader gets an easier time in front and can dictate terms, making it difficult for closers to reel them in. Prominent horses tracking the winner will be best placed to challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong but sustainable, allowing trackers to stay within range
scenarios.body: Those positioned in third or fourth can benefit from the pace without suffering its consequences. The leaders soften each other up just enough for a well-positioned horse to strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go off too fast and tie up before the final furlong
scenarios.body: An unsustainably quick early pace sees both front-runners surrender their advantage well before the line. This creates a sprint finish from the back markers with closing speed decisive.

watchPoints.text: Fitzella and Hassaleh could set suicidal fractions if both are determined to lead from the start
Hollywood Treasure's fitness after 244 days off with new trainer Kevin Philippart De Foy
Princess Petrol's last run produced a poor effort and she needs to bounce back sharply
Zooming requires the leaders to go fast enough to set up her late kick from the rear
Argentine Tango's draw and tactical speed make her a key player if the pace becomes moderate

races.paceDynamic: Shes Perfect will lead from the gates with Blue Bolt likely tracking just behind, creating a measured pace through the early stages. The prominent pair should establish a comfortable rhythm without excessive pressure, allowing the four hold-up horses (Never Let Go, Kon Tiki, Arisaig, Betty Clover) to settle behind. With only six runners and no confirmed speed horses beyond the front two, this sets up as a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial in the straight. This race shape favours prominent runners who can avoid traffic and kick from a forward position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shes Perfect and Blue Bolt establish an uncontested lead through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The front two control the race from pillar to post, with their superior tactical position proving decisive when the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Blue Bolt's stronger recent form gives her the edge in a sustained duel.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and allows a strong closer to unleash
scenarios.body: Never Let Go or Arisaig times their run perfectly, sweeping past the leaders in the final furlong when the pace collapses. Never Let Go's recent form edge makes her the most likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get into a cat-and-mouse game with nobody wanting to commit early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole, suiting horses with natural speed over pure stamina. Blue Bolt's class advantage becomes telling in a rough-house finish where positioning matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the market principles fail to fire and connections have found significant improvement
scenarios.body: Kon Tiki or Betty Clover produces an unexpected career-best performance, capitalizing on a true-run race that suits their profiles. The 316-day break may have freshened Kon Tiki considerably.

watchPoints.text: Blue Bolt's market position in the betting ring will reveal connections' confidence after her lengthy 210-day absence
Shes Perfect's early pace-setting - if she goes too fast or too slow it will determine the entire complexion of this small-field contest
Never Let Go's position turning for home as she needs clear running room to unleash her trademark late charge
Any significant market moves on Kon Tiki given her long absence and the yard's inconsistent recent strike rate
The pace through the first four furlongs will be crucial in this tactical affair where positioning beats pure speed

races.paceDynamic: Aggagio will take this race forward from the start and is unlikely to face any serious pressure given the field composition. With six runners carrying hold-up styles (Novelista, Percy Shelley, Appier, Solar Pass, Arc Zoosve, St Mawes), the pace will be moderate to steady throughout. Aggagio's uncontested lead will allow him to dictate fractions and potentially steal a march turning for home. This race shape heavily favours front runners and prominent racers, as the abundance of hold-up horses creates a tactical disadvantage for those needing to close from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Aggagio Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Aggagio gets an easy lead and maintains momentum turning for home
scenarios.body: His uncontested pace-setting advantage becomes decisive as the hold-up horses struggle to close the gap in time. The moderate pace suits his stamina reserves perfectly over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and Aggagio stops in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The closers get their preferred scenario with plenty of horse left for a sustained finish. Percy Shelley's excellent recent form and Novelista's class tell in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If Aggagio maintains steady fractions without going too slow or fast
scenarios.body: The race becomes a fair test where class and current form separate the field. Multiple horses arrive with chances but the strongest finisher prevails.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Aggagio Weakens Early
scenarios.trigger: If Aggagio's 242-day absence tells and he fades before the straight
scenarios.body: A moderate pace becomes a slow pace as no other horse wants the lead early. This creates an even more advantageous scenario for the hold-up brigade with maximum time to deliver their challenges.

watchPoints.text: Aggagio's jumping from the gates and early positioning will dictate the entire race flow
Percy Shelley's ability to secure a clean passage through the field given his reliance on pace
Novelista handling the return from 211 days off the track in what could be a slowly-run race
Solar Pass and Arc Zoosve potentially being outpaced if any acceleration occurs before the straight
The general pace through the middle sections - if too slow it negates Aggagio's advantage completely

races.paceDynamic: Tiger Tulip and Tanjen will go forward early as the two confirmed front runners, with both having strong lead preferences and returning from breaks. Solvency and Faustus may sit prominent behind this early pace battle. The small field and presence of two genuine leaders suggests an honest gallop from the start, with the pace likely holding up well over this minimum trip at Goodwood. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fast, as the early pace battle between Tiger Tulip and Tanjen will set up a perfect scenario for closers to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tiger Tulip and Tanjen engage early and maintain a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be genuine throughout, setting up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to finish strongly over this sharp 5f trip. The front runners will have done too much work early and fade in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy lead while the other fails to fire
scenarios.body: Tiger Tulip or Tanjen could steal a march and hold on, particularly if the pace becomes more moderate than expected. The hold-up horses may leave themselves too much to do over this minimum distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go too fast and the hold-up horses are too far back
scenarios.body: Solvency or Faustus from prominent positions can strike the perfect balance, tracking the pace without getting involved in early speed battles. They can then pounce when the leaders tire but before the back markers arrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Tiger Tulip and Tanjen disappoint after their long breaks
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no genuine pace, turning into a sprint finish where any running style can win. Freshness and recent form become more important than tactical position.

watchPoints.text: Tiger Tulip and Tanjen both face significant fitness questions after breaks of 183 and 223 days respectively, which could undermine the expected pace scenario
Watch for Solvency and Faustus to be ridden more aggressively than their prominent style suggests if the early pace is insufficient
The Thames Boatman running after just 5 days could show signs of fatigue despite his hold-up style suiting the race shape
Spring Bloom's recent yard change to John Butler could see improved tactics, particularly if held up further than previous runs
Rory Rocket's low weight of 122lbs makes him dangerous if the pace sets up right for his strong finishing kick

races.paceDynamic: Lord Melbourne will take this field along from the front with Love Beach, Urban Glimpse and Samuel Colt likely to race prominently behind him. With only one confirmed front-runner, Lord Melbourne can dictate a steady gallop without pressure, allowing the field to bunch up heading into the straight. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Yabher, Circus Of Rome, Majestic, and Alpha Crucis will look to produce their efforts late. This setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit what should be a solid but not breakneck pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Melbourne sets steady fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be sustainable allowing the field to stay compact, setting up a cavalry charge finish that suits the closers perfectly. Quality hold-up performers like Yabher and Circus Of Rome can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racers capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Melbourne gets into an early speed duel or goes too fast
scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch the field and give horses racing closer to the pace a tactical advantage over those held up. Love Beach and Urban Glimpse can kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical positioning pays
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow and turns into a sprint
scenarios.body: Horses with the best tactical speed regardless of normal running style will benefit from being in the right place at the right time. City Of Delight's recent good form and Yabher's class could shine in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Melbourne goes extremely slowly and no one challenges
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 3f pole where early positioning trumps everything else. Samuel Colt and Love Beach sitting close to the pace can steal a march on the field.

watchPoints.text: Lord Melbourne must handle the pace-setting role competently as his recent form shows declining performances.
Alpha Crucis has never won on turf despite 15 attempts which is concerning given his current good form on the all-weather.
Urban Glimpse faces a significant fitness test after 295 days off despite his smart previous course form.
Yabher's hold-up style perfectly suits this race shape if Cieren Fallon can get him into the right position.
City Of Delight's exceptional Goodwood record makes him dangerous if the pace sets up right for his finishing kick.

races.paceDynamic: Northern Empire, Sea The Power, and Ohara will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Six runners (Mohaaraj, Law Court, Berkshire Boom, Dumuji, Lyra Lea, Midnight Rodeo, Born A Star) want prominent positions, creating severe congestion and traffic problems approaching the final two furlongs. The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over this straight mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Akho Mezzna, Chapter, and Celestarak who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong pace holds
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Empire and Sea The Power maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the prominent pack and sets up perfectly for closers with clean runs. Hold-up specialists benefit from the strong end-to-end pace testing stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent battle royal
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners engage in early tactical warfare
scenarios.body: Traffic problems intensify as runners bunch approaching the turn, creating gaps for the patient hold-up horses. The pace becomes stop-start, suiting those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Empire and Sea The Power go too fast early
scenarios.body: The leaders weaken dramatically in the final furlong after setting unsustainable fractions. Mid-division runners with stamina like Midnight Rodeo pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire shock
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: Northern Empire or Sea The Power steal a march while the prominent pack squabbles behind. The leader maintains just enough in reserve to hold off late challenges.

Traffic congestion approaching two furlongs out as six prominent runners converge on limited racing room
Berkshire Boom's fitness after 280-day absence, longest break in the field
Akho Mezzna getting a clean run through from the back as the pace-setters stretch the field

races.paceDynamic: Jeddaal and Harlequin Breeze will engage early as the confirmed front runners, with Jeddaal looking the more reliable pace-setter given his recent 7f win at Goodwood. Do Bronxs, Major Neigh Sayer and Monarch's Gold will track prominently, creating a decent tempo through the middle sections. The strong contingent of hold-up horses (Shaman Champion, Mystic Moment, Siren Suit, Deluded, Startled) suggests the pace will be honest rather than breakneck. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the front two go too hard early and the hold-up brigade leave it too late.
scenarios.body: Do Bronxs or Major Neigh Sayer can capitalize from their ideal position, tracking the pace without engaging in the early battle. The prominent runners get first run on the struggling leaders while the back markers need too much ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Jeddaal sets steady fractions and the pace collapses in the final 2f.
scenarios.body: Startled and Shaman Champion can unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace as the early tempo proves insufficient. The patient tactics pay dividends when the front runners fold late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jeddaal gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The Ed Walker runner repeats his recent Goodwood success by controlling the tempo from the front. His proven course form and tactical speed prove decisive when he quickens off steady fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Meltdown Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast and the prominent trackers also get drawn into battle.
scenarios.body: The entire front rank collapses, allowing a deep closer like Deluded or Mystic Moment to sweep up from the rear. The extreme change of pace catches everyone off guard except the most patiently ridden.

watchPoints.text: Jeddaal could get an easy lead if Harlequin Breeze fails to go forward, making the Ed Walker runner very dangerous.
Do Bronxs showing early pace despite 232-day absence would signal full fitness and make him a major threat.
Major Neigh Sayer getting prominent position early without being bustled suggests Darragh Keenan is confident.
Startled being held up further back than usual would indicate connections fancy a big finishing kick.
